---
title: "MEA absorption-column research"
subtitle: "Model choices, retained evidence and numerical methods"
---

## Research focus

This project studies when thermodynamic and film-model detail changes predicted
carbon-dioxide capture and axial temperature, and what numerical effort resolves
those differences. Research is active; the submitted manuscript revision is
preserved separately under `docs/scientific/latex/`.

## Ownership

This repository owns absorber integration, transport and film closures, and
numerical comparisons on explicitly stated common input bases. The ePC-SAFT
Engine owns generic thermodynamic equations; MEA-Thermodynamics owns fitting
and parameter adoption. The submitted revision remains unchanged while new
research proceeds in this repository.

## Reading the analyses

Use the sidebar to move between retained analyses. Each page states its question,
conditions, retained evidence and limits. Exploratory calculations and numerical
completion do not by themselves establish physical accuracy or manuscript
promotion.

## Rendering boundary

The site renders registered Quarto sources and retained files with execution
disabled. Model calculations are run separately into new result directories;
rendering does not execute them or replace retained results.
